outcome.description: done when you finished the work; needs_input when the issue cannot be implemented without answers from a person.

pullRequest.description: The text Foundry publishes your work with: the pull request it opens, or a summary comment on the existing one.

summary.description: One line summarising the change, without a type prefix; Foundry adds it.

body.description: Markdown description of the change for reviewers. Foundry links the issue itself.
